{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Empire's Twilight''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Atrig system]], near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abatrang|Abatrarg]]. The crew of forty-five escaped the ship, and landed on the planet with enough supplies to survive for a week.
